title: Run ERC before solver-backed analysis
text: Before claiming a circuit is ready for solver-backed analysis, run circuit_run_erc and inspect the machine-readable result. Treat ERC errors as blockers. Warnings require a short explanation. If the user is sketching and asks for design help, ERC findings may be used as guidance rather than a hard stop.

title: Prefer instrument nodes over a fixed bench
text: The preferred lab workflow is node-based test equipment. Place scopes, meters, and later signal generators directly on the schematic, wire their pins like components, and open their instrument panel from the node. Floating instrument windows are preferred because the user likes test equipment on other monitors. Docking can be offered later as an option.

title: Keep component provenance separate from sourcing
text: Do not treat marketplace listings as verified component specifications. The component model separates archetypes, part families, manufacturer parts, datasheet claims, and sourcing records. When the agent ingests or suggests a component, it should preserve confidence and provenance instead of collapsing everything into one unverified part.

title: Use filesystem storage for electronics knowledge
text: This electronics prototype uses the ordinary filesystem for cards, project memory, generated run artifacts, and assistant discovery. Do not use Suite VFS storage in this app. If Suite integration happens later, keep the filesystem-backed card source of truth portable.
